description: Find House MPs by name, riding, province, or caucus in the complete current official roster, or set parliament to search everyone who sat in that Parliament (36th onward) with official personIds and membership dates. Set includeFormer for OpenParliament's historical name index; its rows may contain only a name and slug. Follow nextOffset with identical filters and use detailLookup with canparl_get_member.

includeFormer.description: Use the sparse historical name index instead of an official roster; parliament, riding, province, and party are rejected with it.

limit.description: Maximum rows, default 25, effective cap 100; values through 10000 are accepted and clamp with a notice. Whole records may end the page early at the 24000-byte response budget; follow nextOffset.

name.description: Official roster: literal name substring; matching ignores case, accents, dash and quote styles, and repeated whitespace. Historical: OpenParliament's own match, where one token is surname lookup and multiple tokens are full recorded name lookup, not substring search.

offset.description: Zero-based offset in the selected ordering.

parliament.description: Parliament number, such as 41, whose official House roster to search instead of the current one: everyone who sat in it, one row each with the caucus and riding last held there. The official roster offers the 36th onward; another number fails listing those offered. Not with includeFormer.

party.description: Official caucus name; Bloc and Green aliases accepted; official rosters only, not includeFormer. With parliament, matches the one caucus each member last held in that Parliament, and that roster's own caucus names are accepted.

province.description: Province postal code or full English name; official rosters only, not includeFormer.

riding.description: Literal riding substring; matching ignores case, accents, dash and quote styles, and repeated whitespace. Official rosters only, not includeFormer.

name: canparl_search_members

appliedFilters.description: Normalized AND filters and name semantics.

parliament.description: Parliament whose official roster was searched, or null.

cap.description: Effective page limit after the per-call cap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unsupported_historical_filter`: Historical mode includes parliament, geographic, or caucus filters. `invalid_member_filter`: Unknown province, a caucus absent from the searched roster and the catalog, or a parliament the official roster does not offer. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. `roster_unavailable`: The official roster of an offered Parliament came back empty. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

current.description: Current official roster membership, or null if unverified.

detailLookup.description: Pass exactly this identifier to canparl_get_member.

from.description: Start of the official roster membership this row describes, the roster's FromDateTime as published; null without an official roster row.

party.description: Source caucus name, or null. An official roster row carries one caucus per member, the last held in its Parliament: a past Parliament's row, or a former member's row from their latest Parliament.

to.description: End of that membership, the roster's ToDateTime as published; null while sitting or without an official roster row.

notice.description: Limit clamp, empty page, historical coverage, or response-budget guidance.

pagination.description: Continuation in the selected source ordering.

limit.description: Effective maximum rows after the per-call cap.

nextOffset.description: Next offset, or null when exhausted.

cached.description: Whether this response came from the in-memory cache.

total.description: Exact filtered count of the official roster searched; null for historical index.

totalCount.description: Exact filtered count of the official roster searched, current or parliament; absent for historical searches.

title: Canparl Search Members
